item.title: Black Bean, Sweet Potato and Tenderstem Broccoli Bowls (V) from Full of Beans
item.description: "This is one to get your gut microbes partying. We all know beans are GREAT for our gut health, thanks to their high fibre content. The seed topper adds crunch, but also packs in a few more plant points to make this dish sing." item.title: Tuscan-Style Sausagemeat Broth from The Farm Kitchen
item.description: "This simple rustic soup is hearty and warming and packed full of vegetables, beans and peas, simply perfect to give your gut all the nourishment it needs to thrive during these brutal winter months. With a sprinkling of turmeric, rich in phytonutrients, this brothy soup is full to the brim with antioxidants, fibre and vitamins." item.title: Chana Dal (VG) from Easy Indian Vegetarian
item.description: "This is a family recipe of Bhumika, who lovingly cooked it for me in her beautiful kitchen in Gujarat. Once I started eating it, I found it hard to stop. Served with some Coriander and Ginger Chutney or Tamarind Chutney, it’s an unforgettable feast." item.title: Vietnamese Crispy Pancakes (VG) from Leon Fast Vegan
item.description: Chantal first tasted these perched on a child’s plastic chair at the side of the Hoi An river in Vietnam.
